verdicts.method: code and data reading at HEAD; git log -S for origin
verdicts.evidence: analysis.js:280-282 decision claim est, why 'The hour is disputed: about eight in Segur, ... half past eight in Thiebault, ... about nine in the Austrian accounts'; analysis.js:314-316 guard-attack est, 'The hour is disputed: Rapp and Segur ... about 13:00, Schonhals ... by about noon'; analysis.js:350-352 ice fact (its why is about the drowned, not the hour) and data.js:122 its phase line 'The accounts differ on the hour: Schonhals ... half past two; Thiebault ... last half hour of the firing'. CLAIM.disputed data.js:20 fits all three. evNoteParts app.js:3886-3888 gives 'hour disputed' only for claim 'disputed': decision and guard-attack are labelled '(interval)', ice nothing; the dossier says CLAIM[e.claim].note (app.js:8328), e.g. 'the figure or frontage shown is an estimate'. Decision 201 (b) (docs/step4-evidence/questions.md:240-252) was applied to the seven events from question 193; these texts date from step 4 (aa561af, 69031df, 14 Oct), before 201: inherited.
verdicts.notes: Agree S3. P2 or P3: a guarded data task (analysis.js), 'dispute' with both hours (test.js:194 requires the hours in it), labels measured as 201 (b) did. Consistent with decision 201 (b); no decision covers the gap.

verdicts.method: own probe on an isolated copy (model's posAtClock, plateauStrength, anchorList); code and records reading
verdicts.evidence: docs/audit-post8-evidence/verification/v-batch-his/kamensky.txt: kamensky 08:00 [259,316] -> 08:44 [268.78,298.4], true bearing 46.5 deg (NE), 0.636 km, Pratzeberg 1.19 -> 0.60 km; Langeron's own leg 0.171 km; enters PLATEAU_POLY at 08:29, Allied reading 19,300 -> 23,550, French 0 until 09:15; sthilaire at [206,231] through 08:45. anchorList: ph2 arr 480, ph3 arr 525, so the leg runs 08:00-08:45. Disclosures: data.js:799 'in the 08:45 phase in his brigade's record'; analysis.js:299 'turns it in the 08:45 phase'; app.js:64 'his own record and the track in phase 3'; chronology.js:259 'the engine arrives 08:45'; docs/STAGE2_SPEC.md:1172 records the leg as 08:00-08:45.
verdicts.notes: The leg's timing is decision 42's 'today's behaviour' for the named conflict (CONFLICTS kamensky@3, chronology.js:446) and is accepted as such. The defect is that the disclosures name the arrival, not the walk drawn from 08:00, plus the lift in the derived reading. The record fix is consistent with decision 42. A moveMin hold would be a timing that no source dates, so it is the owner's choice under decisions 40-42. The area's 'heading 151 deg' is not a compass bearing: the true bearing is 46.5 deg (its 'north-east' is right). Inherited: the texts came in 56501de (step 4 K4). S3 P3 agreed.

verdicts.method: own probe (nearest formation centre of each side to [208,365], 15-min steps); code reading of the block extents; visual-landscape capture re-read
verdicts.evidence: docs/audit-post8-evidence/verification/v-batch-his/sokolnitz.txt: from 09:00 to 13:15 the nearest French centre is legrand at 0.95-1.19 km, then friant at 0.80-1.21 km; the nearest Allied is prz at 0.79 km throughout. friant's closest all day is 0.80 km at 12:45. legrand stands 0.07 km off at 08:00 and is back to 0.23 km at 13:45. lang@2 [235,350] (A, 'Storms Sokolnitz', data.js:508) is 0.976 km from the village and 0.452 km east of the brook. FEATURES (data.js:707) says 'Defended by: Legrand, then Friant'; the arrow note at app.js:47 says 'the model has the column at the village from 08:00'.
verdicts.notes: 'Drawn empty' holds for centres. But blocks have width: up to 7 subunits (app.js:833-838), an infantry front of up to about 1.1 km (app.js:1630-1636). In visual-landscape/shots/sok-village-1200-west.jpg the III Column's block abuts the castle group's farmsteads at 12:00. So no block occupies the village, but figures stand beside it. Inherited. S3 P3 agreed.

verdicts.method: code reading (marchRow, marchRate, GAIT); own probe over the day
verdicts.evidence: app.js:7917-7930 labels the row 'Marching' whenever marchRate.moving (app.js:3347-3354: u in (0,1), at any rate). GAIT.KMH=1 (app.js:5812, 5863) treats a leg under 1 km/h as a drift. docs/audit-post8-evidence/verification/v-batch-his/drift.txt: rg_cav at 07:37 is 3.23 km in 435 min, 0.44 km/h, moving, with status 'In reserve'. Over the day 14,021 formation-minutes show 'Marching' under 1 km/h, 5,443 of them with status reserve, concealed, holding or forming. docs/audit-post8-evidence/verification/v-batch-his/rgcav-plateau.txt: rg_cav enters PLATEAU_POLY at 10:05 and the Allied reading goes 18,150 -> 21,050.
verdicts.notes: Inherited (the row predates Stage 8: 0a19964). Related, not duplicates: visual-landscape #2 (facing along drifts) and tests #6 (the march-row pin). Decision 45 keeps the drift; it does not cover the row's word. S3 P3 agreed.

verdicts.method: data, world and register reading; the project's own 6B reading of Schonhals p. 178; other areas' results
verdicts.evidence: Krug: VILLAGES Krug [339,139] and Holubitz [340,89] (world.js:142-143) lie 1.58 km apart, while the acts pair 'Krug and Holubitz' (data.js:613). The Second Survey's 'Kruch' is beside Holubitz at docs/stage8-evidence/8k/register.md:36 (the cited :43-45 is the post-house entry). SOURCE_NOTE (data.js:798-799) discloses both places as open; there is no qualifier on the label. Kologrivov: docs/stage6-evidence/readings-composition.md:540-548 (al.rg.oob.schoenhals) reads 'GL. Kollowrizow' in Schonhals 1873 p. 178's order of battle, 'a second source for that name'. So data.js:640 'in Sokolov alone' and SOURCE_NOTE are the error (sources-oob #4), not an unqualified label.
verdicts.notes: The Krug/Bellowitz part is substantively geography #6. The Kologrivov premise fails, and the proposed remedy ('Sokolov alone' in the field) would entrench the error.
